judged_text: The disqus import task silently drops its --category option and switches its code path to TopicEmbed.import_remote, changing the created posts' cook_method and permalink shape for existing task users. Anyone with a scripted `disqus import -c Category` invocation gets an unrecognized-option failure (or silent ignoring depending on Thor version), and posts created after the change are raw_html imports with an 'Imported from' footer rather than plain cooked posts — an unversioned behavioral break of a maintained entry point.

Anyone with a scripted `disqus import -c Category` invocation gets an unrecognized-option failure (or silent ignoring depending on Thor version), and posts created after the change are raw_html imports with an 'Imported from' footer rather than plain cooked posts — an unversioned behavioral break of a maintained entry point.

adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` line is removed and all logic that reads `options[:category]` and passes `category: category_id` into `PostCreator` is deleted. The import path is switched to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`, which ultimately creates posts via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and appends an "Imported from" footer in `TopicEmbed.import`. This is a concrete backward-incompatible change to the existing `disqus import` CLI entry point: `-c/--category` is no longer accepted and imported post content/cooking behavior changes.
